title: Secretly
description: Secretly Slack bot: detections, obfuscations, dismissals, pipeline health and runtime.

panels.title: Messages obfuscated
panels.description: Messages that contained at least one sensitive value and were masked.

panels.title: Sensitive values found
panels.description: Individual detections; one message can contain several.

panels.title: p95 processing time
panels.description: 95th percentile time from receiving a message to writing its audit entry.

panels.title: Processing errors
panels.description: Messages that failed mid-processing. A failed message may have been left unmasked.

panels.title: Rate limiter errors
panels.description: Redis errors in the rate limiter. Requests are let through (fail open) when this happens.

panels.title: Obfuscated messages by severity
panels.description: Per minute, by the highest severity found in the message.

panels.title: Detections by type
panels.description: Sensitive values found per minute, by detector.

panels.title: Messages scanned and skipped
panels.description: Per minute. Rate-limited messages are not scanned.

panels.title: Processing time
panels.description: Time from receiving a message to writing its audit entry.

panels.title: Dismissal requests by outcome
panels.description: Per minute. 'dismissed' restored the original message; 'denied' lacked permission.

panels.title: Channel config changes by outcome
panels.description: Per minute. 'denied' means a non-admin submitted the config modal.
